# 哨站已重建！ / Outpost Rebuilt!

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/on_action_events_1.txt:7700-7820; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:99 on_monthly_pulse · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

每月脉冲（00_on_actions.txt:99）检查没有星港的孤立殖民地：若星系中没有敌对舰队或他国殖民地干扰，则重建前哨站。

On the monthly pulse (00_on_actions.txt:99) orphaned colonies without a starbase are checked: if no hostile fleets or foreign colonies interfere, an outpost is rebuilt.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

action.91“哨站已重建！”：创建前哨星港；“水果起源”首次殖民改为触发 origin.7400。

action.91 "Outpost Rebuilt!" creates the outpost starbase; for the Fruitful origin's first colonisation origin.7400 fires instead.
